about: Oxygen and pressure NASA logged under 'ISS environment' for each BASS test, from its as-run test matrix. Applied to tests.json by build_web_data.py; validate_data.py re-reads every cell when data_extra/ is present. Values describe the test session's atmosphere, not a reading during the burn. Tests marked diluted ran in nitrogen-diluted air in the glovebox work volume; NASA's notes give the oxygen as calculated. CO2 is listed but not applied (see scripts/bass_conditions_from_candidates.py).
